_about: What each of KitCut's narrator voices says in the site's voice picker (scripts/voice-samples.py). One sentence a narrator would really say, 6 to 8 seconds, no direction: the picker is for hearing the voice itself. Keyed by language; the site plays the one in the film's language when it has it, else English.

text.en: Every film starts with a single idea. This is how it sounds when I tell your story.
text.uk: Кожен фільм починається з однієї ідеї. Ось як звучить ваша історія моїм голосом.
